verdict.rationale: The core skill lifecycle is exposed programmatically. Skills can be uploaded and managed through a dedicated Skills API with a Skill Versions API. They are invoked in the Messages API via the `container` parameter, either as pre-built IDs or private custom skills. The Agent SDK can also control which skills are invoked, dispatch them by name and load plugins programmatically. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party parity statement mapping Claude.ai UI skill features to API equivalents, an API-only constraint of 20 skills per request, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the Skills API itself.
